claim: Features: projects, tasks with list, board and Gantt views, resource planning, finance, time tracking, templates, planner, client portal, CSV import and export
Tech stack: React and Ant Design, TypeScript and Express, PostgreSQL, SeaweedFS, S3 or Azure Blob, Redis, Nginx
Docker quick-setup script generates secrets, configures SSL; compose starts PostgreSQL, Redis, SeaweedFS
Self-hosted build includes Planner, Finance and Client Portal; SMTP relay for invitations
